summary: Build practical digital marketing strategy skills with SEO, paid media, analytics, and campaign planning. Enquire now.
lede: Digital marketing strategy provides a structured way to align audiences, messages, channels, budgets, and measurement with business goals. This course covers funnel design, content planning, keyword research, channel selection, SMART goals, KPI definition, and reporting through Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads. You will practice creating audience personas, mapping content to funnel stages, planning SEO priorities and paid media tests, and outlining dashboards, campaign briefs, and a 90-day action plan. The training also introduces automation for email marketing and campaign reporting, helping you coordinate activity across channels while working with limited budgets, fragmented data, approval cycles, and AI-assisted content workflows.
audienceIntro: This digital marketing strategy training is designed for professionals who already work with digital channels and need a more structured way to plan, measure, and optimize performance across the full funnel.
audience: Business Development Manager using digital campaigns
prerequisites: Participants should have a working familiarity with basic marketing concepts, campaign terminology, and common digital channels such as SEO, social media, email, and paid advertising. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing campaign data in Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and spreadsheet-based planning templates. The course is most effective if you bring a laptop and, where available, a recent campaign report, a sample content calendar, or a channel performance dashboard to use during exercises.
